overall_reason: The docs mark the current place at three levels and keep Ant's full state set, but at 375 the in-page anchor rail keeps its column and squeezes the article until labels break one letter per line, and the version select stayed open after Escape.

score.reason: T-WHERE-AM-I passes at 1440. T-PHONE-NAV fails on the anchor rail at 375 (CMP-011), and T-OVERLAY-CHECK fails on the version select and the contributors dialog (CMP-013).

findings.where: div.ant-anchor (in-page anchor rail) beside article, 375px, tiles/375-00.png and tiles/375-03.png
findings.evidence: At 375 the anchor list ('Design Principal', 'Types', 'Common Butto...', 'Do & Don't', ...) keeps a column of about 150 px on the right. The article column shrinks to about 170 px: 'Edit this page' and 'LLMs.md' wrap one letter per line (tiles/375-00.png), and the Do and Don't figures are cut off at the left edge (tiles/375-03.png). The sweep's targets check lists the anchor links at 112x19 px.
findings.before: The desktop anchor rail stays beside the article on a phone.
findings.after: Under 60rem, fold the anchor list into an 'On this page' disclosure above the article and give the article the full width.
findings.why: On a phone the reader gets a 170 px text column, broken labels and clipped examples on a page whose job is to be read.
findings.title: The phone gets the whole navigation

findings.where: version select #_R_7bbqfsua_ ('6.7.0') in the header, 1440px, motion/t1-normal-600.png
findings.evidence: The overlay row for t1 records an 88x264 list (6.7.0, 5.x, 4.x, 3.x, 2.x, 1.x, 0.12.x, 0.11.x) and closed_after_escape: false after Escape and a pointer move away.
findings.before: The version list stays open after Escape.
findings.after: Close the version select on Escape and return focus to it.
findings.why: A select that ignores Escape behaves unlike every other select the reader knows.
findings.title: Overlays are the last answer and behave as overlays

findings.where: button 'contributors (10)' at the end of the article, 1440px, motion/t0-normal-600.png
findings.evidence: The click opens a centred modal with a full-viewport scrim (covers_viewport: true, 1440x900) to show ten contributor names and avatars. It has a close control and closed after Escape.
findings.before: A modal dialog with a scrim shows a list of ten names.
findings.after: Show the names in a popover anchored to the avatar row, or expand the row in place.
findings.why: A modal blocks the page and moves focus for a short read-only list that a popover or disclosure handles without taking the page away.
findings.title: Overlays are the last answer and behave as overlays

findings.evidence: The fields row has placeholder_only: true and placeholder_instruction: true. The sweep's form_labels check reports 'placeholder "Type keywords..." is not a label' (A11-010).
findings.before: The docs search carries its only label as an instruction placeholder.
findings.after: Use the placeholder 'Search docs' to name the scope, with a label and the keyboard shortcut shown in the box.
findings.why: 'Type keywords...' tells the reader how to type, not what the box searches.
findings.title: Every field shows its label and what it needs

strengths: The current place is marked at three levels: 'Design' is underlined in the header, 'Button' is selected in the sidebar (class and link to this page), and the anchor rail moves a blue bar to 'Label' (motion/t0-normal-600.png).
The image preview opens with a scrim, a close button, a zoom and rotate toolbar, and closes on Escape (motion/t2-normal-600.png).
Ant's state set is declared: hover 563, focus-visible 153, active 95, disabled 212 rules.
At 375 the header folds to the logo and a menu icon (tiles/375-00.png).
not_investigated: the specimens in the article (Default, Primary and Text buttons, the Do and Don't figures) are exhibits and are not judged as interface
'中 En' navigated away when clicked: not verified
the header icons (RTL switch, theme) changed nothing in their 80x72 stills, but these switch page-wide modes that may take more than 600 ms, so they are not judged
the clipped figures at 375 may also be a robustness finding (sideways overflow): the sweep's overflow check reported 0
inline validation and error placement after invalid input: the capture fills valid values and never types an invalid one
what the phone menu holds and how it opens and closes: the capture opens triggers at 1440 only
focus moving into an overlay and back to its trigger, scroll lock and backdrop click: not recorded by the capture
keyboard operation of custom widgets: lens-a11y
flows beyond the captured page and states reached only with real data
